field_principles.board_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents this CPU/CUDA sampler study from reopening board or TSU scope.
field_principles.cpu_device_receipt: Authenticates CPU identity, runtime, and free memory for the local benchmark.
field_principles.crossover_claim_allowed: Requires quality and timing gates to pass together before any crossover claim.
field_principles.crossover_size: Records the smallest gated crossover size, or null when no crossover is proven.
field_principles.cuda_device_receipt: Authenticates CUDA identity, driver/runtime, and free memory or records a precise blocker.
field_principles.energy_quality_metrics: Prevents speed from hiding wrong samples by reporting energy and exact constraint quality.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every headline and gate field exists before a reviewer trusts the JSON shape.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete: or blocked: verdict states whether no-crossover evidence is final.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares matched CPU/CUDA exact Ising sampling, not LLM inference or board timing.
field_principles.instance_sizes: Makes the tested crossover range explicit instead of implying unmeasured scale.
field_principles.mixing_metrics: Reports ESS and autocorrelation to test whether the corrected cDLS mechanism actually mixes.
field_principles.models_tested: Names sampler methods only, keeping the unchanged discrete baseline and corrected cDLS kernel separate with no LLM implied.
field_principles.quality_gate_results_by_pair: Explains every pair's inclusion or exclusion before timing enters a speedup claim.
field_principles.random_seeds: Duplicates the paired seeds in methodology form for verifier compatibility.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the benchmark artifact and sufficient-statistic receipt.
field_principles.samples_per_pair: Guards the >=10000 retained-sample floor required for mixing estimates.
field_principles.seeds: Records at least five paired seeds so every CPU/CUDA and method comparison is reproducible.
field_principles.speedup_by_pair: Reports only matched ratios with intervals; failed or quality-inferior rows cannot enter speedups.
field_principles.successful_matched_pairs: Lists only quality-matched complete method/device pairs; failed rows do not enter speedups.
field_principles.sufficient_statistics_path: Points to recomputable energy, constraint, and timing evidence instead of trusting summaries.
field_principles.sufficient_statistics_sha256: Pins the sufficient-statistic file used to recompute ESS, autocorrelation, quality, and timing.
field_principles.target_descriptors: Proves both methods sample identical exact Ising Hamiltonians.
field_principles.timing_intervals_by_size: Aggregates paired-seed ratios into intervals so a crossover cannot rest on one lucky row.
field_principles.timing_rows: Preserves raw matched timing evidence, including failed rows, before any summary ratio.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipt: Proves Exp5622 exactness prerequisites are fixed before GPU work is allocated.
